verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an API reference with an interactive playground, Markdown versions of pages, and an llms.txt index. None of these is a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, so they are adjacent features, not this capability. The probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and no doc mentions a spec download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
